_comment: Real Object 3 (Group Object Table) content and its real PID_MCB_TABLE checksum, captured via a genuine koolenex Partial Download to 1.1.10. Reassembled in address order from the 5 real MemExtWrite chunks actually sent (0xC2000/228, 0xC20E4/228, 0xC21C8/228, 0xC22AC/228, 0xC2390/30 = 942 bytes total), and cross-checked against the real device's own PropertyValue_Read P=27 response captured immediately after the write in the same session - not a synthetic value, per this project's standing rule to validate protocol claims against real captured downloads.

object3.note: The same device's Object 3 checksum immediately BEFORE this write (same session, read at the start) was 0x1DB8 - a different, earlier real ETS Partial Download capture also recorded 0x1DB8 for this device at that time (a checksum cited elsewhere as 'C327' is from a still-earlier, separately-timestamped capture whose own Object 3 content was never saved as a byte fixture and can no longer be reconstructed, since the device's content has since changed).
